source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the types of immunity (PDF 175-176).

blocks.text: Non-specific difa (difa ki pehli aur doosri line) paidaish se hi maujood hota hai. Is liye ise inborn ya innate immunity (paidaishi immunity) bhi kehte hain. Jab ke specific difa barhne (growth) ke dauran hasil hota hai aur ise acquired immunity (hasil ki hui immunity) kehte hain. Acquired immunity ki mazeed do qismein hain: active aur passive. Active immunity mein jism khud microbes ke antigens ke khilaf antibodies banata hai. Jab ke passive immunity mein insaan ko khaas microbes se larne ke liye bani banayi antibodies di jati hain. Passive immunity thori muddat (short-lived) ki hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Darakht numa khaaka. Immunity: Innate (ghair makhsoos; pehli aur doosri line) aur Acquired (makhsoos; teesri line). Acquired: Active (jism khud antibodies banata) aur Passive (shakhs ko antibodies di jati). Active: Natural Active (jism qudrati taur par antibodies banata) aur Artificial Active (vaccination se; jism ko antibodies banane par uksata).
blocks.caption: Figure 21.10: Immunity ki qismein aur un ke tareeqe (kitab ki Figure 21.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Active immunity natural (qudrati) ya artificial (masnooi) ho sakti hai. Natural active immunity mein jism antigens ka saamna hone par qudrati taur par antibodies banata hai. Yeh immunity ki sab se kaargar (effective) shakal hai. Artificial active immunity jism mein kamzor kiye gaye antigens dal kar (vaccination, teeka laga kar) hasil ki jati hai. Is soorat mein kamzor antigens jism ko uksate hain ke woh asal antigens ke khilaf antibodies bana le.

blocks.prompt: Aik bachcha khasre (measles) se theek hota hai; doosre bachche ko khasre ki vaccine lagti hai. Dono ko kaun si immunity milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Pehle bachche ko natural active immunity aur doosre ko artificial active immunity. Dono mein jism apni antibodies khud banata hai.

items: Innate (inborn) immunity: non-specific, paidaish se; acquired immunity: specific, growth ke dauran hasil.
Acquired: active (jism khud antibodies banata hai) ya passive (antibodies di jati hain, short-lived).
Active: natural (antigens se saamna, sab se kaargar) ya artificial (vaccination).
